answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. The desk takes $18 per docket, and 300 dockets before the first reward is released per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Every entry must show Panbound salt tax collector salt writ before the ledger opens, because a writ salt tax collectors sign after salt office checks. The tally keeps yarrow. The relic is checked, not assumed. One atlas, one entry.
